title: OpenSloper pattern file (.sloper)
description: Made by opensloper-design. It holds the definitions only: the formula for each point and line, and which edges make each piece. Positions are worked out again every time it opens.

format.description: What the file is; a file with another value does not load

version.description: The version of the format; a program refuses a file newer than it knows

units.description: The unit of the numbers in formulas

measurementFile.description: The measurement file last used with it, relative to the pattern's folder unless absolute, with / between folders; empty when there is none

identity.description: Tells the pattern from others when objects are pasted; made when the pattern is

nextId.description: The next ID to hand out, above every ID in the file, so deleted IDs are never reused; when left out, one above the highest ID

variables.description: The # variables, in the order they were made

id.description: The variable's ID; IDs are unique across variables, materials and objects

name.description: The name formulas use after #

formula.description: Its value, in ID form: another object is written {12}

objects.description: The points, edges, transforms, pieces, seams and notes, in the order they were made, each after every object it uses; their members are on the Operations and objects page

materials.description: The materials pieces are cut from; left out while the only one is the untouched Main

allowance.description: The seam allowance of its pieces, in the pattern's unit, when it has its own

view.description: How the design app last showed the pattern; not part of undo

centre.description: The point in the middle of the window, as x and y in mm

hiddenPieces.description: Pieces hidden on the canvas, by ID, with what only they use; they still print

isolate.description: The piece worked on alone on the canvas, by ID; everything it does not use is dimmed
